from machine import I2C, Pin
import framebuf, time
i2c = I2C({I2C_ID}, sda=Pin({SDA}), scl=Pin({SCL}))
ADDR = 0x3c
def command(c):
    i2c.writeto(ADDR, bytes([0x00, c]))
for c in (0xae, 0x00, 0x10, 0xb0, 0xdc, 0x00, 0x81, 0x6f, 0x21, 0xa0, 0xc0, 0xa4, 0xa6, 0xa8, 0x3f, 0xd3, 0x60,
          0xd5, 0x80, 0xd9, 0x1d, 0xdb, 0x35, 0xad, 0x80):
    command(c)
time.sleep_ms(200)
command(0xaf)
buf = bytearray(128 * 64 // 8)
fb = framebuf.FrameBuffer(buf, 128, 64, framebuf.MONO_HMSB)  # Waveshare getbuffer: bit (x % 8) of byte y*16 + x//8
def show():
    command(0xb0)
    for y in range(64):
        column = 63 - y
        command(0x00 + (column & 0x0f))
        command(0x10 + (column >> 4))
        i2c.writeto(ADDR, b'\x40' + buf[y * 16:(y + 1) * 16])
fb.fill(0)
fb.text('TOP', 0, 0, 1)
fb.text('BOTTOM', 0, 56, 1)
show()
print('drawn')
